# plus

Positive and unlabeled Learning from Unbalanced cases and Sparse
structures (PLUS)

## Installation

You can install the development version of plus from
[GitHub](https://github.com/alrobles/PLUS) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("alrobles/plus")
```

The goal of plus is implement the Positive and unlabeled Learning from
Unbalanced cases and Sparse structures (PLUS) algorithm, originally
published in:
[PLoS](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1009956)
\## Example

The use of plus is very simple:

``` r
library(plus)
data(binexample)
x = binexample$x
y = binexample$y
plus(x, y)
#> 
#> Call:  glmnet::cv.glmnet(x = train.X, y = y, family = "binomial") 
#> 
#> Measure: Binomial Deviance 
#> 
#>      Lambda Index Measure      SE Nonzero
#> min 0.00777    35  0.3383 0.10399      17
#> 1se 0.04147    17  0.4411 0.06799       8
```

You can predict new data:

``` r
data(binexample)
x = binexample$x
y = binexample$y
train <- sample(seq(length(y)), 85, replace = FALSE)
x_train <- x[train, ]
x_test  <- x[-train, ]
y_train <- y[train]
y_test  <- y[-train]
fit <- plus(x_train, y_train)
predict(fit, newx = x_test)
#>       lambda.min
#>  [1,]  0.9099319
#>  [2,]  0.9988322
#>  [3,]  0.9212976
#>  [4,]  0.3999964
#>  [5,]  0.3390931
#>  [6,]  0.7253012
#>  [7,]  0.9839539
#>  [8,]  0.7999568
#>  [9,]  0.5424189
#> [10,]  0.9999993
#> [11,]  0.9939600
#> [12,]  0.9996293
#> [13,]  0.9805778
#> [14,]  0.9982364
#> [15,]  0.8101654
```

Additionally you can get evaluation performance metrics for the plus
models

``` R
#> [1] 0.4044118
#> $deviance
#> lambda.min 
#>   1.280583 
#> 
#> $class
#> lambda.min 
#>       0.32 
#> 
#> $auc
#> [1] 0.4044118
#> 
#> $mse
#> lambda.min 
#>  0.4468466 
#> 
#> $mae
#> lambda.min 
#>  0.8697495
```

The plus algorithm can be applied in different datasets

# Package index

## All functions

- [`assess()`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/assess.md) :
  Assessment of performance metrics in plus models

- [`auc()`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/auc.md) : Gets the
  Area under ROC curve usingthe concordance statistics

- [`auc_matrix()`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/auc_matrix.md)
  : AUC evaluation for matrix (data.frame) data

- [`binexample`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/binexample.md)
  : List with 100 random values for binary classfication It contains a
  list with x and y values. x.has 100 instances and 30 features. y is a
  vector of 100 binary (1 and 0) values. This dataset is for test plus
  classification.

- [`cutoff_example`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/cutoff_example.md)
  : Example of cutoff threshold from plus model for use in the
  consturctor function new_plus

- [`fit_plus_example`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/fit_plus_example.md)
  : Example of plus model for use in the consturctor function new_plus

- [`get_auc()`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/get_auc.md) :
  Assessment of auc metrics in plus models

- [`get_predictions()`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/get_predictions.md)
  : Get predictions to asses model performance from a fitted plus model.

- [`lacs`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/lacs.md) : Data
  frame with 5990 abstracts. Each abstract belongs to one of both
  classes, positive and unknown. Abstracts from parasite class are from
  ZOVER and GMPD database. Abstracs from unknown class are random
  abstracts retrived from crossref.

- [`lacsSample`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/lacsSample.md)
  : Data frame with 600 abstracts. Each abstract belongs to one of both
  classes, positive and unknown. Abstracts from parasite class are from
  ZOVER and GMPD database. Abstracs from unknown class are random
  abstracts retrived from crossref.

- [`new_plus()`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/new_plus.md)
  : Constructor function for the class plus A constructor for the plus
  class

- [`plus()`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/plus.md) : plus
  model helper function

- [`plus_cv_lognet()`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/plus_cv_lognet.md)
  : Evaluation metric of plus classification

- [`plus_object_example`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/plus_object_example.md)
  : Example of plus object from new_plus constructor

- [`predict(`*`<plus>`*`)`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/predict.plus.md)
  :

  make predictions from a "plus" object. This function makes predictions
  from plus object. Is in essence a cross-validated glmnet model,
  optimized with the plus algorithm. It use the optimal value chosen for
  `lambda` for a fit.

- [`predicted_coefficients_example`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/predicted_coefficients_example.md)
  : Example of prediction from plus model for use in the consturctor
  function new_plus

- [`predicted_y_example`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/predicted_y_example.md)
  : Example of prediction from plus model for use in the consturctor
  function new_plus

- [`print(`*`<plus>`*`)`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/print.plus.md)
  : print a plus object

- [`validate_plus()`](https://alrobles.github.io/plus/reference/validate_plus.md)
  : validate plus_object constructed via new_plus function
